tools.name: upcoming_decisions
tools.description: Policy-rate decisions in a date window, soonest first: decision day (local to the bank), announcement time in UTC where the bank publishes one, whether the date is on the bank's calendar, moved or unscheduled, the rate going in, and the decision once observed. tools.name: bank_status
tools.description: One bank: the policy rate in force and since when, the last observed decision with its statement, the next meeting, past facts computed from observed decisions only (days since the last change, consecutive holds, counts of past move sizes), freshness and data warnings.

tools.name: check_question
tools.description: Is a question about a rate decision or a government bond auction settleable, when, and on which source? Finds the bank (or the auction issuer, tenor) and the date in the text. Refuses a decision or auction that has not been observed: a decision settles only after its statement is observed on the ban

tools.name: upcoming_auctions
tools.description: Government bond auctions in a date window, soonest first: US Treasury, the German Finanzagentur and the Italian Treasury, calendar and results. tools.name: resolution_sources
tools.description: The kinds of page a bank publishes (decision statement, calendar, rate history, press feed): where each URL is found, its pattern (for recognising a page, never for building one), a real example, the reads recorded on it, and whether it is resolvable.

tools.name: submit_correction
tools.description: Report a mistake with the URL of the bank's own page that proves it. The report is public and is checked like any other claim; it never changes the data by itself. Returns the report id and where to follow it.

tools.name: dataset_health
tools.description: Freshness per bank (last observed decision, next meeting, days to it, whether its decision statement is resolvable) and the publisher-gate warnings. Use to judge how far to trust an answer.
